tagline.en: vivo Camera Research's camera-controlled world model — steer a video with camera trajectories from a single image.
tagline.zh: vivo Camera Research 的相机可控世界模型——从单张图片出发,用相机轨迹操控视频。

en: MagicWorld is an interactive world model from vivo Camera Research. Starting from an image, it generates video you can steer with camera motion, letting you explore a scene along a chosen trajectory.

It builds on established video and geometry tooling: a Wan2.1-Fun image-to-video backbone for generation and Apple's Depth Pro for depth, combined so camera control stays grounded in the scene's 3D structure. WorldFoundry also wires a dedicated MagicWorld-Fast camera path.
In WorldFoundry you give it a starting image and a camera trajectory, and it renders a camera-controlled clip through the shared pipeline.
zh: MagicWorld 是 vivo Camera Research 的交互式世界模型。它以一张图片为起点生成视频,你可以用相机运动来操控,沿选定轨迹在场景中漫游。
它构建在成熟的视频与几何工具之上:以 Wan2.1-Fun 图生视频骨干负责生成,配合 Apple 的 Depth Pro 估计深度,使相机控制始终锚定在场景的 3D 结构上。WorldFoundry 还接入了专门的 MagicWorld-Fast 相机路径。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你给它一张起始图片和一条相机轨迹,它就会通过统一 pipeline 渲染出一段相机可控的片段。

whenToUse.en: Use MagicWorld when you want to explore a scene from a single image with explicit camera control — panning, orbiting, or moving through it along a trajectory.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从单张图片出发、用明确的相机控制(平移、环绕、沿轨迹推进)去探索一个场景时,适合使用 MagicWorld。

notFor.en: The released model materials carry a non-commercial, share-alike license, so it isn't suited to unrestricted commercial use. Checkpoints are downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 该模型发布材料采用非商用、相同方式共享的许可,因此不适合无限制的商业用途。Checkpoint 需单独下载。
